items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: me and this guy, Carl Peter, somebody from Norway. And he and I walked the whole way from where they started to the end, right along with the Young Tuxedo Band.

ctx.x: Oh, it wasn't you, your daughter. Okay, it was somebody else himself.

Well, one of my reactions to that parade was that they weren't in the second liners. That the only thing that even came close to it was me and this guy, Carl Peter, somebody from Norway. And he and I walked the whole way from where they started to the end, right along with the Young Tuxedo Band. And every once in a while there'd be a little knot of people on the sidewalk that would kind of get with it a little bit and clap as he went by. But there was basically no second line. And I was very much aware of that.…
Well, I know exactly what you're talking about in that case. I'd hate to generalize. Maybe there are things going on that we don't know anymore about.
